_meta.note: Indicative specs and price ranges compiled from public sources for demo purposes. Prices vary by trim, market and time — always confirm current pricing via web_search or a local dealer. Bare brand names (Toyota/丰田, Land Rover/路虎, Ford/福特) default to the same-segment flagship in this catalog.

tank500.name: GWM Tank 500 HEV

offroad.diff_locks: electronic rear (and front on Off-Road trims)
offroad.terrain_modes: all-terrain control system with multiple modes

selling_points: Full hybrid powertrain rare in the body-on-frame off-road SUV class
Luxury interior (Nappa leather, massage seats) at a value price point
Genuine off-road hardware: ladder frame, low range, locking differentials
7 seats standard; long warranty typical for GWM markets

toyota-land-cruiser-prado.name: Toyota Land Cruiser (250 Series / Prado)

powertrain.type: 2.8L turbo-diesel (EU); 48V mild-hybrid on newer model years

selling_points: Legendary Land Cruiser reliability and resale value

tank500_advantages: Significantly lower price for comparable size and equipment
Full hybrid petrol (no diesel emissions concerns in city zones); more power and torque
More luxury features standard (massage seats, larger screens)
tank500_disadvantages: Brand recognition and resale value in Europe far below Toyota
Land Cruiser has longer off-road pedigree and proven durability record

land-rover-defender-110.name: Land Rover Defender 110

powertrain.type: D250 3.0L I6 diesel MHEV (base); petrol P300/P400, PHEV P400e and V8 available
powertrain.drive: permanent AWD with low range, air suspension optional

offroad.diff_locks: center + optional rear active locking differential

selling_points: Premium brand image with iconic design
Class-leading off-road geometry and wading depth
Wide engine lineup from diesel to V8 and PHEV

tank500_advantages: Lower purchase price, especially against comparably equipped Defenders
Ladder-frame simplicity; hybrid standard without PHEV price premium
tank500_disadvantages: Land Rover premium badge and interior design language
Air suspension and configurable Terrain Response not available on Tank 500

ford-explorer-phev.name: Ford Explorer PHEV (EU, 2019-2023 model years)
ford-explorer-phev.availability_note: New sales in the EU largely ended around 2023; mainly available used. The current EU 'Ford Explorer' is an unrelated mid-size EV. Verify local availability via web search.

efficiency.note: WLTP combined for PHEV assumes charged battery; real-world petrol consumption is much higher

price_range_indicative.uk: not officially sold new (LHD-only in EU)

selling_points: Strong combined output and torque from V6 PHEV
Large 7-seat family SUV with US-style space
Low taxable emissions (PHEV) attractive for company-car rules

tank500_advantages: Real off-road hardware: ladder frame, low range, diff locks vs unibody soft-roader
Currently on sale as new; Explorer PHEV is effectively used-market only
Higher wading depth and better off-road geometry
tank500_disadvantages: Explorer PHEV has more system power/torque and plug-in electric range
Explorer offers lower taxable CO2 (PHEV) where company-car tax matters
Ford service network in Europe is much denser
